_comment: DESADV (DELIVERY_REQUEST_OUT) Handling Unit lookup. From configured-production.md (MM_SPS_S4HC_CO_EDI_DELIVERY_REQUEST_OUT__2__..._cdm_6): service path `srvd_a2x/sap/handlingunit/0001/HandlingUnit`, binding `api_handlingunit`, filter `HandlingUnitExternalID eq '%s'`, key <- /DeliveryRequest/Delivery/HandlingUnit/ID. THIS IS OData V4 / A2X (edmx Edmx Version 4.0, Schema com.sap.gateway.srvd_a2x.api_handlingunit.v0001, EntitySet HandlingUnit). Generate with the V4 skeleton: gen-lookups <outdir> <this> <cpi-lookup-template/skeleton/LOOKUP_TEMPLATE_V4>. 'service_path' supplies the odata4 address segment (api_handlingunit/srvd_a2x/sap/handlingunit/0001); 'service' (API_HANDLINGUNIT) names the edmx file. NO hand-patch needed (the V4 template carries MessageProtocol=OData V4, resourcePathForOdatav4=entity, csrfEnabled, no contentType, base /sap/opu/odata4/sap/). EntitySet key is (HandlingUnitExternalID, Warehouse) so filtering by external id alone can return one row per warehouse. Result fields are a sensible default (packaging + weights) since the PI extractor did not capture the consumed result params — verify against the DESADV target on first test.
